newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich airport Jan-Oct cargo traffic unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Zurich airport Jan-Oct cargo traffic unchanged.

text.p: Total cargo traffic handled at Zurich airport in the first ten months of 1996 was unchanged on the same period last year at 367,148 tonnes, airport authority figures show.

January-October 1996 cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at Zurich airport declined by 3.6 percent on 1995 levels to 200,504 tonnes while foreign carriers' volume was up by 0.6 percent to 65,438 tonnes.
Trucked airfreight grew by 7.6 percent on January-October 1995, to 101,206 tonnes, the airport authority said.
Postal traffic totalled 13,561 tonnes, a fall of 0.8 percent on the same period in 1995. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
